preconditions.description: The number of pastures n is between 2 and 100,000, and the number of paths m is between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi and 1 <= li <= 10**9 for ai, bi, li in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path connects two distinct pastures ai and bi (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ n; ai ≠ bi) with a length li (1 ≤ li ≤ 10^9).
The input contains exactly m paths, provided in the order they are constructed.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 and (line.strip() == '-1' or (line.strip().isdigit() and 1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**9)) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' (no sunny paving exists) or a positive integer representing the minimum possible length of the longest paved path in a sunny paving.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= m for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines(), 1))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines, one for each path added.

postconditions.expression:
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    paths_i = paths[:i]
    edges = [(ai, bi, li) for ai, bi, li in paths_i]
    sunny_paving_exists = any(
        sum(1 for (a, b, _) in selected_edges if a == u or b == u) % 2 == 1
        for u in range(1, n + 1)
    )
    for selected_edges in itertools.combinations(edges, len(edges)) if sunny_paving_exists
    max_length = max(li for (_, _, li) in selected_edges) if sunny_paving_exists else -1
    output_line = str(max_length) if sunny_paving_exists else '-1'
    output_line == stdout.splitlines()[i - 1]
postconditions.description: For each i from 1 to m, the i-th output line is the minimum possible length of the longest paved path in a sunny paving using the first i paths, or '-1' if no such paving exists. A sunny paving is a subset of edges where each pasture has an odd degree in the subgraph formed by the paved edges.
